name: Per-Frame SSBO Reconstruction for Voxel Buckets
aliases: New SSBO per bucket per frame
definition: A rendering architecture where GPU instance data (SSBOs) are completely discarded and recreated every frame for each non-empty render bucket, abandoning incremental updates, persistent buffers, and double buffering.
summary: Per-Frame SSBO Reconstruction is a GPU voxel rendering method that discards and rebuilds Shader Storage Buffer Objects every frame, prioritizing synchronization simplicity over bandwidth efficiency.
